title: REQ · Contribution modal is a Radix dialog opened from gameplay with correct focus and keyboard behavior
summary: Replace the plain div dialog with a Radix Dialog opened from the gameplay trigger
description: Context: ContributionSheet renders a div with role=dialog and no focus management. Desired behavior: Radix Dialog gives focus trapping, Escape to close and focus restore to the trigger, without navigation. Expected result: keyboard users can open, use and dismiss the modal. Why: accessibility and polish requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Given the gameplay screen, when the trigger button is clicked, then a role=dialog named 'Suggest What Happens Next' is in the document and location is unchanged
Given an open dialog, when Escape is pressed, then onClose is called and the dialog is removed
Given the dialog opens, then focus is inside the dialog, and after closing, focus returns to the trigger button
definition_of_done: Dialog is Radix-based and keyboard accessible
